changeSet.author: khrvacic
changeSet.comment: The reuse lookup for links made without an account: long_url = ? and active and owner_id is null. A hash index, because a long_url of up to 2048 characters can pass the btree row limit.
changeSet.sql: create index if not exists ix_url_anonymous_long_url on url using hash (long_url) where owner_id is null and active = true
